segments.name: Robotic Magnetic Navigation
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and markets robotic systems, instruments and information systems for hospital interventional laboratories, primarily for cardiac ablation procedures.
segments.evidence: The Company manages the business activities on a consolidated basis and operates in one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals pay an upfront capital payment for equipment and installation plus recurring payments for disposables, service and software.
revenueModel.evidence: This implementation requires a hospital to agree to an upfront capital payment and recurring payments.
